sonnet.problem: The story card turns a promised outcome into a present-tense fact: "Those enemies march out against Israel in one direction but flee in SEVEN." Verse 7 says "will", and it is one of the blessings that depend on obeying. The card drops both the "will" and the condition.
sonnet.rule: A prediction stays a prediction: "God says Tyre will fall," never "Tyre falls."

sonnet.problem: The story card says nothing from verse 5. It never mentions the basket or the kneading bowl. It only teases "something that will be blessed" and "straight out of the kitchen", so it carries no part of the passage and exists only to set up the next question.
sonnet.rule: Every story card tells part of the passage. Jokes ride along on those cards.
